aesthetic.texture: fine paper-grain texture, gentle film grain, deep shadows
aesthetic.light: warm late-afternoon light through office blinds, horizontal slats casting soft striped shadows
aesthetic.palette: ink-on-bone palette, muted ox-blood accent, no saturated colors
aesthetic.motion: slow, restrained, observational; no quick cuts, no zooms past 5 percent
aesthetic.camera: 85mm lens feel, shallow depth of field, locked-off or 1cm dolly only
aesthetic.framing: human-eye level, off-center subject, generous negative space
absolute_ban: any readable text in the scene
any letters, numbers, words on books, spines, papers, monitors, notebooks, calendars, signs, computer screens, or whiteboards
any titles, labels, captions, or handwriting that could be read
any logos, brand marks, or watermarks
abstract orbs, particles, or volumetric light beams
drone shots, fast cuts, fast zooms

Cinematic documentary-style background footage of a quiet wood-trimmed desk in a working office. On the desk: a single sheet of cream-colored paper face-down (no visible writing), a vintage fountain pen resting beside it with a small brass cap, a closed leather-bound notebook with a small oxblood ribbon, a stoneware coffee cup half full. The paper, the notebook, and the cup are all blank surfaces. No visible text anywhere. No people, no faces, no hands.

Lighting is warm late-afternoon sun through office blinds. Horizontal slats cast soft striped shadows across the desk surface and the closed notebook. Fine paper-grain texture, gentle film grain, deep shadows. Color palette is ink on bone, muted oxblood accent on the notebook ribbon, no saturated colors.

Motion is slow, restrained, observational. The camera barely moves, at most a one-centimeter dolly forward. The striped shadows drift almost imperceptibly as if the sun is setting. Shallow depth of field, 85mm lens feel. Eye level with the desk surface. The frame reads as a still from a working-paper documentary, not a software product ad.

ABSOLUTELY NO readable text or letters or numbers in any part of the frame. No words, no labels, no signage, no titles on any object. No logos, no brand marks, no text overlays. No abstract particles, no neon colors, no fast cuts.
